verdict.rationale: Bun's docs show several bulk operations across many packages at once. `bun update` updates every direct and transitive dependency, `--filter` targets glob-matched sets of workspaces with exclusions, and `bun audit` fix upgrades each vulnerable package. Catalogs, dedupe and prune also act across the whole dependency tree, and `bun remove` strips a package from every dependency group. missing for 10: no independent or hands-on corroboration of these bulk commands, no evidence of running scripts in bulk across workspaces, no evidence of adding many packages in one batch.
